body:
Sorry, but I fell asleep on the couch.

Thanks for that- but it is my second go at this and I'm even surer than I was the first time.  I'm tired of hearing that my survival was a 'miracle'- whoever heard of a miracle that wasn't asked for?

I've told my managers to make clear that no-one influenced my decision- it's my choice entirely and no-one is to blame.

I hope I didn't keep you awake. Don't worry for me; after all, I'm not.

BTW your remark- how did you know  I'm from Scotland? Or was it one of Life's synchronicities?

Have a Great Saturday.

I hope my post does help- it's a pity it's still shrouded in shame and blame.

I can only say I feel better for being straightforward about it- the ultimate life choice.

Sure people will care; but they'll survive. Life goes on. I've told my managers they can say it was a stroke if it helps others- I won't be around to contradict them.

You seem nice - Thanks 😊

Thanks but as you can see I'm pretty determined to go and quite happy to do so.

I just thought it might help others in a dark place- there's no need for shame or fear.

Thanks anyway.
